data.narrative:
Ultima Genomics is a Series C-stage biotech company that has raised $700M+ to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 3 public companies (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private peers in the Biotech & Health sector, with particular focus on 3 same-stage private comparables: Colossal Biosciences ($10.3B), Chai Discovery ($3.8B), and New Limit ($3.1B).

Two triangulation methods apply to the analysis. Stage-progression analysis, using the $700M total raised as a proxy base value and applying a 1.7x step-up multiplier typical for Series C progression, implies a valuation of $1.2B. Peer-median analysis across the 3 same-sector, same-stage comparables yields a median valuation of $3.8B, with a range spanning $3.1B to $10.3B. Public-comp anchoring cannot be applied due to absence of disclosed revenue figures. The public Biotech & Health median P/S multiple stands at 9.2x across the 3 listed tickers, but lacks target revenue to operationalize.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $1.0B (low) to $4.4B (high), with a median of $2.5B. This wide range reflects material uncertainty around stage-comparable selection and the outsized effect of Colossal's $10.3B valuation on peer dispersion. Key uncertainties include revenue trajectory, pipeline depth, and whether Ultima commands a premium or discount relative to the broader peer cohort.
